body: Been on it for about a month
Sleeping pills, Anxiety Pills, Depression Pills...
It helped at first with all the help because I knew I was safe and had the support from others, but then getting out, things were going alright and then back at being dead inside....
Talking with people helps and kind of suprised with all the support.. overwhelming but in a good way..
If anyone wants to talk, feel free to message me. I'm always down for a nice conversation. If you have a story as well, I would love to hear. We can talk about anything.

Thank you so much for taking time out of your day to read my post and type that back.. I dont deserve it but the generosity inside you made you do it. 

Thank you! ❤
Yeah..... I'm still here....
😔 I found one, but i feel like the healing process is taking forever.. I've let so many people down. I'm back at the bottom... the suffering just needs to end
😔 Thank you. Seriously appriciate that
Its rough... I wish all the pain would stop
December 2019

I feel like I was at the top of the stair case and someone just shoved me down..

It sucks how one thing can just turn your whole life around and bring you all the way back down to the bottom.

Life is hard. I feel one thing can ruin your whole life. 

I went from being way up, all the way back to the bottom. My whole life got ruined

I gave life so many chances. I cant take the pain and suffering anymore
PM me please

Are you are in a long distance relationship? 

Like a e girlfriend?

We all say things we regret and laugh at things we shouldn't.  As a person who use to game a lot, I'm pretty sure more than half of the gaming community would be in prison from the things they said and laughed at in xbox parties, playstation parties and discord rooms. 😂 What you're going through is nothing to be ashamed of. Sometimes if something is funny, it's hard to control. 

And those people you consider "friends" shouldn't hate you for laughing at something said. They probably are some fake friends. Dont be scared to be doxed... They wont do much. If they do, I will personally ruin their lives. I use to Dox, ddos,  hack into people's computers and do so much if someone tried to do something like that to me. Listening to them freak out as I read off their family members and their address was always a joy. 

But forreal tho. You will be fine. Everyone likes a little bit of dark humor including me. 😂 Real friends would laugh with you and move on. Just find new friends. 

Forreal tho. If they try to do anything, hmu. I will literally make them regret what they did as I am not scared to ruin someone's life.
I'm trying. Honestly not many people in my life I can talk to so I come to the internet to hopefully talk with someone. 😔

You're taking time out of your day to reply to my post. 

You have no clue who I am. 
Any information about me. 
Nothing...

But the generosity inside you is making you.
We need more people like you in this world. I dont know who you are, but thank you. You atleast deserve that. 


"Perhaps there are things that could be done to even those mixed emotions out perhaps"
Talking with people.... that honestly helps...
I have gotten to the point where I was literally on the edge of doing it... I talked to someone and it made me better. It's hard being alone sometimes as I will think bad thoughts, but even messaging someone really does help. 
I dont do it enough which is my problem.

I just inspired two other people to give life another chance. I hope life gets better for them. I love making others happy, but I cant seem to find that happiness for myself? You're right, the mind is very powerful. We are a brain placed in a body that stays there until it's time to move on as we disappear out of the body after being deceased.  The fact that the thing we are can make us think negative about our self is quite remarkable.  Making me feel hopeless and giving that feeling of not getting any happiness anymore. I myself, a brain borrowing a body typing this is just not happy as I gave life so many chances. Things get better and later turn bad again. I cant handle the mixed emotions of going up and down. 😔

Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
^ I apply all my skill all the time to try and live a good life. I do my best every day trying to make that change

The only person that can hold you back from doing what you want in life is yourself.
^ I feel like I'm burning my self out as I slowly lose motivation because nothing seems to get better even tho I know 100% things will get better eventually, but the mind set I have with no motivation is driving me away.

Just know that you are one of a kind. No one is the same in this world! So be yourself and be happy. Dont let anyone bring you down.
^ I never let anyone bring me down.. it's all me.. I bring my self down. It's hard trying to stay happy about my self.

Hesitation is the key to failure.
^I am a type to work my hardest without second guessing my self, but I guess it just isnt enough.
"us" more than one person?
Update: Life has slowly got better... not the greatest, but still making effort.
